label: D1 near episode end (trial >= 95) after a1 led rarely to S2
explanation: Fires only at D1 (99.8% of mass), and only in the last ~10 trials of a 100-trial episode (99.9% of mass at trials 90-99, none before trial 80), when the value head is at its lowest (all activity in the bottom value bin). Within that, it is selective for the previous trial having been a1 -> S2 (a rare transition): 92% of mass has prev_action=a1 and prev_common=0. Unrewarded outcomes and S1-good episodes enrich it, but adding prev_reward==0 lowers F1. The onset is graded: ep_trial>=90 gives recall 0.88 / precision 0.36, >=95 gives P 0.68 / R 0.76 (F1 0.72, mass recall 0.85), >=97 gives P 0.82 / R 0.52. So the feature turns on more strongly the closer the episode is to its end, and the highest activations come in the final trials, often after repeated a1->S2 rare trials. Does not fire at GO or D2, after a2 choices, or after a1->S1 common trials. It is an episode-end timing signal conjoined with the previous a1-rare transition; the soft time threshold is why precision and recall are incomplete. Uses only observed variables.
